$comment: Civitas illa Fortis street urchins distracting the Wealthy citizens (WealthyCitizens.Thieving.js). Wiki (Wealthy citizen): Leo, Julia and Aurelia each distract a citizen at the same time every 84-99 seconds; a player who saw it pickpockets that citizen automatically and always succeeds, and one who didn't gets the sweaty-hands line (a red game message, color=red on the Wiki). rsprox captures (recs 1695, 2332, 3273, 1098-1105, local 1001312, 1001568, 1001592): all three urchins open on the same tick, 143-163 ticks apart; ticks below count from the urchins' opening line. The citizen faces the urchin and walks up on tick 2, sometimes asking about the commotion; both emote every 4 ticks (4-16 and 24-36); the urchin's second line comes on tick 20 and the citizen answers on 23; the urchin's last line is on tick 39, the citizen stops facing it on 40 and says its last line on 41. Players within 6 tiles of an urchin get the notice and sound on tick 0. Citizen replies come from one pool, except the dancer's admirers.
